description: SIM swap + OTP redirection + mule layering ring, Jharkhand, March 2023

reasons: SIM replacement confirmed for 11 victim numbers before fraud calls
Login from new IMEI (351234567890001, 351234567890002) within minutes of each SIM swap
OTP redirected to operator-held SIM; victim OTP calls traceable in call_logs.csv
Rapid debit (< 10 min after login) for all 14 victims
Funds pass through 6 mule accounts with pass-through ratio 1.00 and dwell time < 30 min
Multi-hop layering: victim -> mule -> handler -> kingpin (3 hops)
